I'm ending my turn without trading, mortgaging or selling.

- **No useful moves:** The bank has no houses left and nothing on my board can be built on, so there's nothing to spend my $499 on.
- **Trading isn't worth it:** Gemini has only $76 and two of its six properties are mortgaged, so a deal now gains me little. Its next rent payment will likely bankrupt it anyway.
- **Selling or mortgaging would hurt me:** I'd only lower my rents for no reason.
